en.name: Spaghetti sauce in jars
en.summary: Jarred spaghetti sauce is commercially processed tomato sauce, shelf-stable while sealed for about 18 months from purchase. Once opened it is a different animal entirely: a low-acid cooked food with 4 days in the fridge, which catches a lot of people out.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 18 months from purchase in a cool, dark, dry cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. The seal and the commercial heat processing are what make that possible. Do not keep a jar with a domed lid, a broken seal, or sticky sauce weeping down the outside, and do not return an opened jar to the cupboard, however full it still looks.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within 4 days. That short window surprises people who think of it as a condiment, but jarred pasta sauce is a cooked, low-acid vegetable dish in a jar — closer to leftover soup than to ketchup. Meat or cream varieties sit at the same limit. Take out what you need with a clean spoon and heat that, rather than warming the whole jar and putting it back; each reheat-and-return cycle eats into the four days.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for jarred spaghetti sauce, but freezing is the obvious answer to a jar you cannot use in four days, and tomato sauce freezes well. Pour the remainder into a flat bag or a rigid container with headspace and freeze at −18 °C (0 °F) on the day you open it, not on the fourth day. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; the limit is flavour.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen sauce in the fridge, or tip it straight from frozen into a covered pan over low heat. Bring it to a full boil before serving, and never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A domed lid, or the jar spurting or hissing when opened
Mould on the surface or around the rim
A fermented, yeasty or fizzy character
A sour smell, or sauce that has darkened and separated in the fridge
tips: Freeze the leftover half on the day you open the jar, not later in the week.
Heat only the portion you need; do not reheat the whole jar repeatedly.
Buy smaller jars if you cook for one or two.
Write the opening date on the lid — four days is easy to lose track of.

faq.q: How long does jarred pasta sauce last once opened?
faq.a: 4 days in the fridge at 4 °C or below. It is a cooked low-acid food once opened, not a condiment.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar keep?
faq.a: About 18 months from purchase in a cool dark cupboard, provided the seal is intact.

faq.q: Can you freeze leftover pasta sauce?
faq.a: Yes, and it is the practical answer. Freeze it in a flat bag at −18 °C on the day you open the jar.

faq.q: Can you put an opened jar back in the cupboard?
faq.a: No. Once the seal is broken it needs refrigeration, however full the jar still looks.

zh.name: 瓶裝義大利麵醬
zh.summary: 瓶裝義大利麵醬是經過商業殺菌的番茄醬，未開封時可常溫保存，從購買日起算大約 18 個月。一旦開瓶，它就完全是另一回事：一份低酸性的熟食，冷藏只有 4 天，很多人會在這裡踩雷。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 18 個月。讓它做得到的是密封和商業加熱處理。蓋子鼓起、封口破損，或瓶身外側滲出黏稠醬汁的就不要留；開過的罐子也絕對不要放回櫥櫃，不管看起來還有多滿。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在 4 天內用完。這個短窗口常讓把它當調味料的人意外，但瓶裝麵醬其實是裝在罐子裡的熟製低酸性蔬菜料理——它比較像剩下的濃湯，而不是番茄醬。含肉或含奶油的口味也是同樣的上限。請用乾淨的湯匙取出要用的份量加熱，不要整罐加熱後再放回去；每一次「加熱—放回」都在吃掉那四天。
zh.freezer: 瓶裝義大利麵醬沒有已發表的冷凍期限，但對一罐四天內用不完的醬來說，冷凍就是明擺著的答案，而番茄醬也很適合冷凍。請在開罐當天就把剩下的裝進平放的密封袋或留膨脹空間的硬質容器，放 −18 °C，不要拖到第四天。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，限制的是風味。
zh.thawing: 冷凍醬請放冷藏解凍，或直接蓋鍋小火從冷凍加熱。上桌前要煮到大滾，也絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 蓋子鼓起，或開罐時噴出、有嘶聲
出現發酵味、酵母味或氣泡感
聞起來發酸，或冷藏中的醬明顯變深並分層
tips: 開罐當天就把用不完的冷凍起來，不要拖到週末。
只加熱要用的份量；不要整罐反覆回鍋。
一兩個人吃的話請買小罐。
在蓋子上寫開封日期——四天很容易算錯。

faq.q: 瓶裝麵醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏 4 天。開封後它是熟製的低酸性食品，不是調味料。

faq.q: 未開封的瓶裝麵醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要封口完好，陰涼避光的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 18 個月。

faq.q: 用不完的麵醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且這才是實際的答案。開罐當天就用平放密封袋放 −18 °C 冷凍。

faq.q: 開過的罐子可以放回櫥櫃嗎？
faq.a: 不行。封口一旦打開就必須冷藏，不管罐子看起來還有多滿。
